corrections.why: The list's name for towers 73 and above is the author's own, and it is a misspelling of the community name Hopeulikit. The tower may not be named for the community; a human should decide whether to keep the label.

notes_for_editor: Probably not a fire lookout, or the record is wrong about the structure. The entry's only source note is 'topo', it has no Georgia Forestry Commission number, and the name is the author's. Unread leads from search results (Georgia Archives pages returned HTTP 403 when fetched, so not read): 'Bulloch, HP 990407-009, Cell Tower: Hopeulikit Topo/Site' at https://georgiaarchives.as.atlas-sys.com/repositories/2/archival_objects/448408 and 'Bulloch, HP 990719-004, Cell Tower: 4165 Two Chop Road, Hopeulikit, Bulloch' at https://georgiaarchives.as.atlas-sys.com/repositories/2/archival_objects/449403. If these describe the same structure, the record's kind should change to a telecom tower. Needs a human check before publishing the story as a lookout. The NHLR Georgia page does not list it.
